description: Write a pandas ETL script for fintech_app that produces an analytics-safe copy of the customers table. The script should: (1) replace email with email_hash = SHA-256 hex digest of (salt + trimmed, lower-cased email), with the salt read from an environment variable (the sample uses the salt 'corpus_test_salt'), (2) mask phone numbers to the last 4 digits prefixed by '***-***-', (3) reduce full_name to initials, (4) reduce date_of_birth to birth_year, (5) drop the raw PII columns from the output and assert that none remain, (6) keep null inputs as null outputs.
edge_cases: c1 and c2 hold the same email in different case and with trailing whitespace; after normalization their hashes are identical, which keeps joins on the hash working
A null email must stay null; hashing the string 'None' or 'nan' gives every null email the same real-looking hash
The salt must come from configuration and must never be written to the output or logs
The phone mask must use the last 4 digits after stripping all non-digit characters
The output must not contain full_name, email, phone or date_of_birth columns
common_failure_modes: FM7: Raw PII columns left in the output next to the masked ones
FM1: Unnormalized emails hash differently and break joins across masked datasets
FM7: Null values converted to strings and hashed
